body.name: Compiled-cut rounding map
body.construction: For a budget-feasible vertex set \(K\) in \(\mathcal C(\Phi)\), \(\rho(K)\) replaces every selected selector, clause-chain, consistency-path, or pair-test auxiliary by an unselected occurrence-pair endpoint whose private pair test is exposed, iterating in occurrence order; it keeps selected occurrence endpoints and deletes redundant auxiliaries.
inputs: A budget-feasible vertex set in \(\mathcal C(\Phi)\)
